sources.title: 2020 NFL–NFLPA Collective Bargaining Agreement (executed March 15, 2020)

Later amendments, side letters, current league personnel policies, and individual contracts are not comprehensively captured. The agreement's Final League Year is distinct from the final year of a player's contract.
